values.note: Electric sites (the cheapest RV sites) are $36 a night most of the year and $31 in January-February (Tue 2027-01-12, 2027-02-09); full-hookup sites $41 (Apr-Oct only). Saturday the same as a weekday. A daily vehicle pass ($10-$15 on the CPW page) or an annual Colorado state parks pass is required on top; CPW's reservation fee is charged per stay.

Maximum vehicle length 40-50 ft on the RV sites; several pull-throughs on cpwshop (the 2024 brochure says all are back-in). Paved pads with shade shelters.

values.note: Showers, coin laundry and flush restrooms are summer-only; November-March only vault restrooms and very limited water. Playground, visitor center, boat ramp to the Colorado River.

values.note: Reservation only, on cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, from the day of arrival up to six months ahead; bookable all year (cpwshop: 'Open year round'), though full-hookup sites close November-March. The group campground is reserved through the park office. 14 days in any 28-day period.

note: Fruita section campground near Red Rocks Lake, within walking distance of downtown Fruita (I-70 exit 19, Hwy 340), with views of Colorado National Monument and the Book Cliffs; walkway along the Colorado River and a river boat ramp. Full-hookup sites close November-March. Red Rocks Lake is designated infested with zebra mussels. --Claude
